newsitem.title: USA: JOULE sees 2nd half of FY97 comparable to 96.
newsitem.headline: JOULE sees 2nd half of FY97 comparable to 96.

text.p: JOULE Inc's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Emanuel Logothetis, said the company anticipates revenue and earnings growth in the second half of fiscal 1997 compared to the second half of 1996 and is optimistic that year-to-year annual results will be comparable.

In the third and fourth quarters of the 1996 fiscal year ended September 30, JOULE's net income was $251,000 and $135,000 respectively. JOULE's net income for fiscal 1996 was $1,026,000. Revenues for the third and fourth quarters of the 1996 fiscal year were $11,003,000 and $11,958,000 respectively. The company's total revenue fiscal 1996 was $48,449,000.
In its second quarter and first six months of its fiscal 1997 ended March 31, JOULE's net income was $318,000 on $12,471,000 in revenue and $412,000 on 23,414,000 in revenue.
JOULE Inc is a staffing company which provides technical, office and industrial services.
